messages.content: Give me a two-sentence explanation of what a vector database is.
Rewrite this into a concise but polite email: 'Hey, I looked at the draft and there are still a few issues. Can you clean it up before tomorrow morning? Thanks.'
Return a JSON object with keys project, status, blockers, and next_steps for a hypothetical ML system migration.
I need to compare the latest prices of AMD and NVDA and recommend one to buy this week.

Summarize the following notes into five bullets with one risk and one next step for each bullet:

Project Alpha migrated the auth path to a shared gateway. We still see intermittent 401s in staging when a token is refreshed during a websocket reconnect. Product wants the new UX shipped this week, but the metrics hook is only partially wired. The data team also changed one dashboard definition, so our current weekly numbers no longer match prior reports. Engineering says the regression is probably in the session handoff layer, but there is no single reproduction yet. Support logged three customer complaints about missing notifications after the rollout. Design is blocked on the final empty state copy. Finance needs a forecast for compute cost if we move more background work to the cloud path. Security wants an explicit note about which requests still touch legacy infra.

A service handles 120 requests per second. Each request spends 40 ms on CPU and 10 ms waiting on I/O. If we parallelize the CPU stage perfectly across 4 workers but the I/O wait stays the same, what is the new ideal per-request latency and what throughput bottleneck remains?
